scripts.build: cross-env GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false CI=false ESLINT_NO_DEV_ERRORS=true craco build
scripts.build:windows: cross-env GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false CI=false ESLINT_NO_DEV_ERRORS=true craco build
scripts.build:legacy: cross-env GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false CI=false ESLINT_NO_DEV_ERRORS=true react-scripts build
scripts.test:local: npm run test:unit:ci && npm run test:e2e:player
scripts.test:local:full: npm run test:unit:ci && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.test:e2e:player: playwright test e2e/gestures.spec.js e2e/gestures.freeze-regression.spec.js e2e/homepage-health.spec.js e2e/homepage-gestures.spec.js e2e/mini-bar-layout.spec.js e2e/modal-surfaces.spec.js e2e/player-gestures-contract.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:ci-player: cross-env CI=true E2E_STRESS_ACTIONS=30 playwright test e2e/gestures.spec.js e2e/gestures.freeze-regression.spec.js e2e/gestures.stress.spec.js e2e/homepage-health.spec.js e2e/homepage-gestures.spec.js e2e/mini-bar-layout.spec.js e2e/modal-surfaces.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:live:current: cross-env E2E_LIVE_SKIP_BUILD=1 playwright test e2e/live-earflow-gestures.spec.js --config playwright.live.config.js --headed --project=live
scripts.test:e2e:visual: cross-env E2E_VISUAL=1 playwright test e2e/visual-walkthrough.spec.js --config playwright.visual.config.js --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:visual:player: cross-env E2E_VISUAL=1 playwright test e2e/gestures.spec.js e2e/homepage-health.spec.js e2e/homepage-gestures.spec.js --config playwright.visual.config.js --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:visual:all: cross-env E2E_VISUAL=1 playwright test e2e/ --config playwright.visual.config.js --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:visual:run: npm run test:e2e:visual:player && npm run test:e2e:visual:open
scripts.test:local:visual: npm run test:unit:ci && npm run test:e2e:visual && npm run test:e2e:visual:player
